projects.name: Servant
projects.description: The team chat app: phone app, server, agent bridge and Mac app
rules: Iterate on main with small follow-up commits. Never rewrite pushed history.
Run the server tests and the app's tsc and npm test before pushing.
Deploy the API with server/deploy.mjs and the worker with worker-swap.sh.

projects.name: Design prototypes
projects.description: Clickable prototypes of IRS screens, published on GitHub Pages
rules: Work directly on main, each prototype in a clearly named folder. No branches or pull requests unless asked.
Public information and made-up sample data only.
Run scripts/build_catalog.py and scripts/check_fourth_wall.py before pushing.
Vibe-coding chats work only inside their own folder.

projects.name: The IRS app
projects.description: The IRS app for iPhone and Android (expo-irs)
rules: Every change goes through a pull request. Merge with `gh pr merge --squash --admin` once the checks pass, then report the PR link and the merge commit.
Store and production rollouts happen only on the owner's go.
Never enable a feature flag just because the fixture tests pass.
